name: 79412 · Lubbock, TX
findings: ZIP 79412 (Lubbock) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79412 (Lubbock) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 79412 (Lubbock) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).
